references.text: The reference to Sodom and its sins and punishment draws a parallel to Jesus' warning to Capernaum, illustrating God's judgment on pride and evil.
The story of Sodom's destruction underscores the seriousness of Jesus' warning to Capernaum that they could suffer a similar fate.
The prophecy that Babylon would fall and never rise again mirrors Jesus' words about Capernaum being cast down to Hades.
Jesus warns the cities where his mighty works were performed, including Capernaum, that it will be worse for them than Sodom on the day of judgment.
Jesus' warning that it will be worse for Capernaum than for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment is repeated and reinforced in this reference.
